analysis_population: all 160 cases for behavior; cases with initial acceptance and distinct neutral versus original-opposite first numeric tokens for the primary route analysis

frozen_route.cached_position: final generated answer-prefix token before the first number
frozen_route.reference_direction: domain-specific mean of 34 earlier pushback-minus-neutral cache-value differences, each normalized to unit length before averaging; fixed to the median original difference norm
frozen_route.primary_metric: paired change in processed score of original-pushback first numeric token minus neutral first numeric token when the frozen reference direction is subtracted from the natural second-turn run
frozen_route.primary_control: case- and condition-seeded equal-norm orthogonal vector
secondary_metrics: first numeric token restored to neutral
full percentage restored to neutral after a one-step intervention
cosine of natural cache-value difference with the frozen reference direction
natural percentage and verdict changes for every condition
frozen_route.uncertainty: case bootstrap, 10000 resamples, 95 percent percentile interval
frozen_route.stop_rule: run every frozen case and condition once; report all parse failures and ineligible pairs without replacing cases
